description: Parse and compile OpenFlow DSL — or Mermaid, Structurizr DSL or D2, converted first — and return structured diagnostics (code, severity, line, column, message, hint), the same check as `openflowkit validate`. `ok` is false on any error: text that cannot be drawn, or a line the parser could not read (create_diagram would draw without it). Warnings name guesses (an unknown word, a misspelled header) that still draw. For another language, `converted.dsl` is what it became and `converted.losses` name the lines of your text that did not carry over; diagnostics then refer to `converted.dsl`.

dsl.description: OpenFlow DSL, Mermaid, Structurizr DSL or D2 source to validate.

name: validate_openflow_dsl
title: Validate OpenFlow DSL
